description: This file defines an interface for obtaining PublicKey instances used in JWT authentication within the security service of the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a method to asynchronously fetch a public key based on issuer and key ID.

classes.name: PublicKeyProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides a method to retrieve PublicKeys asynchronously based on issuer and key ID.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the PublicKey corresponding to the specified issuer and key ID asynchronously, returning a CompletableFuture that wraps an Optional of PublicKey.
